main.description: Lists indexed evaluations with optional publisher, evaluator, and subject filters. Values within each array filter use OR; distinct filters use AND. Records remain listed when evaluator entries cannot be projected; malformed entries are omitted from hydrated views while the original record is preserved. Authentication is not required.

evaluators.description: DIDs in any record.evaluators[].did entry, including entries beyond the hydration cap.

subjects.description: Match record.subject.uri by AT-URI with a DID authority; the reference CID is ignored.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction by (createdAt, uri); defaults to desc.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor tied to sortDirection; keep all other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, cursor, sort direction, page size, or query parameter is invalid.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
